description: Freemium Tier System — Gate features into Free (3 members, no multi-picks) and Pro ($49.99/mo, 50 members) tiers with 7 upsell entry points, 4 payment screens (Stripe placeholder), and server-side enforcement.

userStories.title: Add BookieTier data model and tier sync infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a BookieTier enum, Supabase migration, and local tier caching so all views can check the bookie's tier.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BookieTier enum (free, pro) as String/Codable in a new file or alongside Bookie model
Add `tier` property to Bookie SwiftData model with default 'free' if not already present
Add @AppStorage('bookieTier') local cache in a shared location (e.g., TierService or extension) for instant UI reads
Create `isPro` computed property accessible from views (reads from @AppStorage or bookie query)
Create `activeMemberCount` helper that counts players with non-nil bookie_id for the current bookie
Create `memberLimit` computed property: 3 for free, 50 for pro
On login/sync, read bookie.tier from Supabase and update @AppStorage cache
Supabase migration: ensure bookies.tier column exists as text with default 'free'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Check if bookies table already has a `tier` column — it may exist from earlier work. The Bookie SwiftData model is in Booki/Models/. @AppStorage cache avoids async lookups on every view render. The activeMemberCount should count players where bookie_id matches AND auth_user_id is not nil (active, claimed players). SyncService is where tier sync should happen — read bookie record and update @AppStorage.

userStories.title: Build ProUpgradeSheet (Screen 1 - primary conversion screen)
userStories.description: As a bookie on the free tier, I want to see a compelling Pro upgrade sheet so I can understand what I'm getting.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ProUpgradeSheet.swift in Views/Components/ or Views/
Sheet shows: Booki logo, 'PRO' heading in Theme.accent, '$49.99 / month' subtitle

Feature list card with 11 items (50 members, Multi-Pick, Performance by sport, Futures tracking, Recent activity, Smart filters & tags, Manual approval, Acceptance rules, Override & reverse, CSV export, Full history) each with checkmark.circle.fill icon in Theme.accent
Full-width 'Subscribe — $49.99/mo' button in Theme.accent at bottom
'Already Pro? Restore Purchase' tappable text in Theme.textMuted
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links in Theme.textMuted
Optional contextMessage parameter shown above feature list when provided (e.g., 'You've reached the 3-member limit')
Sheet uses presentationDetents([.large]) and dark theme styling
Subscribe button navigates to ProCheckoutView (can be placeholder NavigationLink for now)
Dismiss via swipe-down or X button top-right
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This sheet is presented from 7 different places in the app. Use @Environment(\.dismiss) for the X button. The contextMessage is nil by default — only some entry points provide it. Use Theme.cardBackground for the feature list card, Theme.background for sheet background. Follow existing dark theme patterns from the codebase.

userStories.title: Build ProCheckoutView and ProSuccessView (Screens 2 & 3)
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see a checkout flow and success confirmation so the payment experience feels complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ProCheckoutView.swift — pushed from ProUpgradeSheet's Subscribe button
Checkout has: back button, 'Checkout' title, summary card (Booki Pro $49.99, billed monthly, today's charge, next renewal date)
Stripe placeholder area: Theme.cardBackground card with lock icon, 'Secure payment powered by Stripe', 'Payment integration coming soon' text
Full-width 'Pay $49.99 / month' button present but disabled with .opacity(0.5)
'Cancel anytime from Settings' + Terms/Privacy links at bottom
Create ProSuccessView.swift — shown after successful payment

Success view has: large animated checkmark (use Image(systemName: 'checkmark.circle.fill') scaled large with Theme.accent), 'Welcome to Pro' headline, descriptive text about 50 members and full features
Full-width 'Get Started' button that dismisses all sheets and returns to app
Both views follow dark theme with Theme.background and Theme.cardBackground
Wire ProUpgradeSheet Subscribe button to navigate to ProCheckoutView
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ProCheckoutView is a NavigationLink destination pushed within a NavigationStack (the ProUpgradeSheet should wrap content in NavigationStack). Next renewal date: calculate 1 month from today using Calendar. ProSuccessView won't be reachable in production until Stripe is wired — for now it exists as a built screen. The 'Get Started' button should dismiss using @Environment(\.dismiss) on the sheet's root.

userStories.title: Build SubscriptionManagementView and Settings subscription row
userStories.description: As a Pro bookie, I want to manage my subscription from Settings so I can view my plan details and manage billing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SubscriptionManagementView.swift with: 'Current Plan' card showing 'Booki Pro' + 'Active' green pill, $49.99/month, member since date, next renewal date, members X of 50 usage
'Manage on Stripe' row that opens placeholder URL (will be Stripe Customer Portal)
Footer text: 'Cancel anytime. Your existing members and data are preserved.'
Add 'Subscription' row to bookie Settings between Profile and Balance Alerts sections
Free users: row shows 'Subscription' label, 'Free' value, small 'PRO' badge pill in Theme.accent — tapping presents ProUpgradeSheet
Pro users: row shows 'Subscription' label, 'Pro' value in Theme.accent — tapping pushes SubscriptionManagementView
Uses dark theme styling consistent with other Settings sections
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The Settings view is likely in AccountView.swift or a dedicated SettingsView. Find the bookie settings section and add the subscription row. The 'Active' pill should use the same StatusPill pattern or a simple green capsule. Member since date can be placeholder or read from bookie.createdAt. The 'Manage on Stripe' row is non-functional for now — it can show an alert saying 'Coming soon' or simply not navigate.

userStories.title: Gate dashboard: blur sport breakdown, hide futures and activity on free
userStories.description: As a free bookie, I see a clean dashboard with summary cards, and the sport breakdown is blurred to tease Pro.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard summary metric cards (Net Exposure, Pending Picks, Top Risk, Outstanding) remain fully functional on all tiers
SportPerformanceCard: on free tier, render with placeholder data, apply .blur(radius: 8) and .allowsHitTesting(false)
Overlay a frosted card centered on the blurred section: chart.bar.fill icon + 'Sport Breakdown' title + 'See which sports are winning for you' subtitle + 'Unlock with Pro' teal text button
Tapping 'Unlock with Pro' presents ProUpgradeSheet with contextMessage 'Unlock analytics'
Futures Tracking Card: completely hidden on free tier (not blurred, just absent)
Recent Activity Feed: completely hidden on free tier
On Pro tier, all dashboard sections render normally (no blur, no hiding)
Dashboard feels clean on free — simpler, not broken
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The dashboard is in AnalyticsDashboardView.swift. The blur overlay is the ONE blurred section in the entire app — keep it tasteful. Use ZStack for the blur + overlay card. The frosted overlay card should use .ultraThinMaterial or Theme.cardBackground with some opacity. Read isPro from the tier infrastructure built in US-001. Only ONE blur on the entire dashboard.

userStories.title: Gate members tab: hide smart filters, tags, and search on free
userStories.description: As a free bookie, I see a simple member list without smart filters or attention tags.
acceptanceCriteria: Free tier: search bar is hidden on Members tab
Free tier: filter chips bar (All, Attention needed, Overdue, etc.) is completely hidden
Free tier: attention tags (On Heater, Whale, Degen, etc.) are NOT rendered on member cards
Free tier: member list shows all members sorted by name with basic info (name, balance, record, credit utilization)
Pro tier: search bar, filter chips, and attention tags all render normally
Add capacity banner below last member card when at member limit on free: 'X of 3 members · Upgrade for more' on Theme.elevatedBackground or Theme.cardBackground card
Capacity banner is tappable → presents ProUpgradeSheet with contextMessage 'You've reached the 3-member limit'
Capacity banner only shows on free tier at capacity (3 members)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The members tab is in PlayersListView.swift. The filter chips, search bar, and attention tags were added in recent phases. Wrap them in if isPro { } checks. The capacity banner goes at the bottom of the list — use a Section footer or append to the list. Use Theme.elevatedBackground if it exists, otherwise Theme.cardBackground.

userStories.title: Gate invite creation at member capacity
userStories.description: As a free bookie at the 3-member limit, I see a clear upgrade prompt when trying to invite more members.
acceptanceCriteria: When a free bookie at member limit taps 'Invite Member', the InviteMemberSheet still opens
Inside the sheet, show blocking message: 'You've reached the 3-member limit on the Free plan.'
Show 'Upgrade to Pro to invite up to 50 members.' description text
Show 'Upgrade to Pro' CTA button in Theme.accent → presents ProUpgradeSheet with contextMessage
The actual invite creation form/button is hidden when at capacity on free
When NOT at capacity (under 3 members on free, or on Pro under 50), invite flow works normally
Archived/removed members (no bookie_id link) do NOT count toward the limit
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Find the InviteMemberSheet or invite creation view. The gate is INSIDE the sheet, not before it — the button to open the sheet is always visible. Count active members using the helper from US-001. Check bookie_id is not nil AND auth_user_id is not nil for active member count.

userStories.title: Gate multi-pick on player-side BetSlipSheet
userStories.description: As a player whose bookie is on the free tier, I see that Multi-Pick is disabled with a message to ask my organizer to upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: In BetSlipSheet, the 'Multi-Pick' tab in the mode selector is visible but grayed out (reduced opacity) on free tier
Tapping the disabled Multi-Pick tab shows inline message below selector: 'Multi-Picks aren't available yet. Ask your organizer to upgrade.'
Message uses Theme.textSecondary, small font size
Singles mode works identically on both tiers
The check is based on the bookie's tier (not the player's account) — read via the player's linked bookie record
When bookie upgrades to Pro, multi-pick becomes available immediately for all players (no app update needed)
On Pro tier, Multi-Pick tab works normally with no message
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: BetSlipSheet.swift has a mode selector for Singles vs Multi-Pick. The player needs to know their bookie's tier. This is available through the player's bookie_id → bookie record (check if there's a @Query for the bookie or if it comes through environment). The player may need to read the bookie's tier from the synced Bookie model via SwiftData query. If the bookie's tier isn't synced to the player's device, it may need to be added to the player sync or stored in @AppStorage during claim_player. This is the intentional social pressure mechanism — players asking 'why can't I do multi-picks?' drives bookie upgrades.

acceptanceCriteria: Free tier: hide 'Require Manual Pick Approval' toggle
Free tier: hide 'Grade Picks Manually' toggle
Free tier: hide 'Allow Futures in Multi-Picks' toggle
Free tier: hide 'Acceptance Rules' navigation link
Free tier: show single replacement row: 'Pick Management' label with lock.fill icon, 'Pro' badge, and brief description 'Manual approval, grading rules, and more'
Tapping the Pick Management Pro row presents ProUpgradeSheet (no contextMessage needed)
Free tier: hide Export Data row entirely
Pro tier: all settings toggles and rows render normally, Pick Management Pro row is hidden

Keep Balance Alerts, Change Password, About, and Logout available on all tiers.

userStories.title: Gate transaction history to last 30 entries on free
userStories.description: As a free bookie, I see the 30 most recent transactions with a footer prompting upgrade for full history.
acceptanceCriteria: In PlayerActivityView (and any inline history sections), limit displayed entries to 30 on free tier
After the 30th entry, show a footer row: 'Showing last 30 transactions' in Theme.textSecondary
Below that, 'Upgrade to Pro for full history' as tappable text in Theme.accent
Tapping the upgrade text presents ProUpgradeSheet with contextMessage 'See your full history'
Pro tier: show all entries with no footer/limit
The 30 entries should be the most recent (sorted by date descending, take first 30)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Gate override actions in BetDetailView on free tier
userStories.description: As a free bookie, I don't see override or reverse settlement actions on bet details.
acceptanceCriteria: Free tier: 'Reverse Settlement' button is hidden in bookie BetDetailView
Free tier: 'Override Grade' button is hidden in bookie BetDetailView
Free tier: if no actions are available (all hidden), the Actions card section is completely hidden
Pro tier: Actions card shows all available actions based on bet state (same as current behavior)
No upsell placement in this view — actions are simply absent on free
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: BetDetailView is in BetsListView.swift (the bookie bet detail). Find the actions section and wrap override/reverse buttons in isPro checks. If the section becomes empty, hide the entire card.

userStories.title: Add tier enforcement to create_invite and submit_parlay edge functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side tier checks so limits can't be bypassed by API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: create_invite edge function: before creating invite, count active players (bookie_id matches AND auth_user_id is not null)
create_invite: read bookie.tier, set limit to 3 for free, 50 for pro
create_invite: if count >= limit, return 403 with JSON { error: 'member_limit_reached' }
submit_parlay edge function: read bookie.tier before processing
submit_parlay: if tier !== 'pro', return 403 with JSON { error: 'pro_required' }
Both functions read tier from bookies table using the authenticated bookie's ID
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Edge functions are in supabase/functions/. create_invite may be in create_invite/ or a similar directory. submit_parlay is in submit_parlay/. Both already have auth validation — add tier check after auth but before business logic. Use the service role client to read bookie.tier. The member count should match the client-side logic: players where bookie_id = bookieId AND auth_user_id IS NOT NULL.

userStories.title: Add debug tier toggle via triple-tap on version number
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a hidden debug toggle to test tier gating without payment.
acceptanceCriteria: In Settings, triple-tapping the version number (in About section) toggles between free and pro tier
Toggle updates @AppStorage('bookieTier') immediately
Show a brief confirmation: 'Debug: Tier set to Pro' or 'Debug: Tier set to Free' (use a toast or temporary overlay)
All tier-gated UI updates immediately when debug toggle fires
This is for development/testing only — does NOT sync to Supabase
The gesture should be non-obvious (triple-tap, not visible button)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Find the About section or version display in Settings (AccountView.swift). Add .onTapGesture(count: 3) to the version Text view. Toggle the @AppStorage value. The confirmation can be a simple withAnimation overlay or use a @State showDebugToast bool that auto-dismisses after 2 seconds. This is crucial for testing the entire tier system before Stripe is wired.
